Nasdaq Just Backed Kraken at a $21B Valuation

Nasdaq's venture arm agreed to invest $100 million in Payward,
Kraken's parent, valuing the company at $21 billion on September
10. As part of the expanded partnership, Kraken will offer
tokenized Nasdaq-listed stocks with full voting rights.

Payward will also adopt Nasdaq's market surveillance technology
across all its trading venues covering crypto, equities,
tokenized equities, futures, and options.
